note: Pixel measurements read from references/tudor-ranger-36-m79930-0001/tudor-m79930-0001_900x1200.png (900 x 1200 photo px). pivot = hand hub hole (dark dot at about 451.5, 667); case_edge_left_x = alpha edge of the case on the pivot row (199; anchors 36 mm, 14.0 px/mm). rings = radii in px from the ring centre (the photo's dial/bezel circle is centred at 449.8, 666.6, 1.2 px left of the pivot): dial_flat 200 (end of the black dial print, start of the grey rehaut), crystal_edge 213 (end of the rehaut), bezel_in 215 (start of the polished chamfer), bezel_out 249 (end of the flat brushed top; the silhouette is at 250.8). tip_rows_px = lug steps of the silhouette (369 top, 970 bottom).
